findings.post: Trump claims Apple will spend $100 million on U.S. titanium for new iPhone production
findings.why: A direct statement about a large Apple procurement could boost investor confidence in AAPL and signal increased domestic demand for titanium, potentially benefiting Apple and related supply‑chain stocks.
